description: This source file is a PHP class definition for a controller in the OpenCart admin extension, specifically for handling product viewed reports. It contains methods for listing, viewing, saving settings, generating, installing, uninstalling, and reporting product view data within the admin panel of OpenCart.

classes.name: ProductViewed
classes.description: Controller class for managing 'Product Viewed' report in OpenCart admin extension, providing functionality for listing, viewing, saving settings, generating reports, and lifecycle management (install/uninstall).

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main entry point for rendering the product viewed report form, initializing language, breadcrumbs, loading components, and outputting the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of report settings via POST request, with permission checks and JSON response.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles installation of the report module, invoking appropriate model method.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles uninstallation of the report module, invoking appropriate model method.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Generates the report data and returns it as a view output.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list report view of product viewed data.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves JSON string of product view report data for AJAX requests.

methods.name: generate
methods.description: Generates report entries, including clearing data and adding new report data, typically via AJAX.
